title: Origin story: Poseidon
description: Poseidon was the brother of Zeus and Hades, freed from Cronus's belly to fight in the Titanomachy. He drew the sea in the great lottery and built his golden palace beneath the Aegean. He contested Athena for Athens, fathered the Cyclops Polyphemus, and hounded Odysseus across the seas for a decade.

title: Ability profile: Poseidon
description: Ranked abilities: Sea command — rank 100/100; Earthquake generation — rank 97/100; Storm-calling — rank 95/100; Endurance — rank 93/100; Horsemanship — rank 90/100.

title: Power ranking: Poseidon
description: Powers: The trident, which splits earth and raises waves; Command of every sea creature; Power to grant or deny all sea passage.

title: Stamina feats: Poseidon
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Raged against Odysseus for a decade without tiring; Held the seas through the Titanomachy and after.

title: Crossover notes: Poseidon
description: Poseidon crosses naturally with: sea, earthquakes, horses.

title: Cultural impact: Poseidon
description: The trident remains the universal emblem of sea power.
